The story of our milk is really the story of our cows and our land. We milk a herd of Brown Swiss, Jersey, and Montbeliardes. Our cows eat fresh grass every day during the pasture season, which here in the Adirondacks is roughly May to November. During the winter, our cows eat hay and non-gmo grain. Our cows make delicious, sweet milk, all of which is turned into cheese!

18 Sugar House Way, Upper Jay NY
